entry.title: Open MPC Plugin Manager 1.1.2
entry.summary: Browse the OpenMPC catalog and install, update and remove plugins on the MPC itself, with rollback; for Gen1 and Gen2. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61). The installer refuses anything else. Newer models are untested. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock MPC OS doesn't offer this; you need a modded unit. - Tested on MPC OS with a Force. Installing plugins this way is unofficial: back up

entry.title: Open MPC Plugin Manager 1.1.0
entry.summary: **Now called "Plugin Manager"** (it was "Plugin Manager G2", which read as Gen2-only: it runs on Gen1, Gen2 and the Force). In the browser: **External VST Plugins → OpenMPC → Plugin Manager**. The old "…Plugin Manager G2" folder is removed automatically, however you update. **Fixes for MPC OS 3.10.1** - Plugins already in VST2 Plugins (copied by hand, by the installer app, or from a 3.10.1-format download) show as installed instead of being offered again. - Plugins built with Akai's SDK (Acid 3,

entry.title: Open MPC Plugin Manager 1.0.0
entry.summary: **MPC OS 3.10.1 ready, and a web page for your phone or computer.** - **MPC OS 3.10.1 and later:** with Preferences > Enhancements > External Plugin Support on, plugins install into `VST2 Plugins` on the drive you choose, ready for 3.10.1. Plugins you already had move there in one tap (**Move**); your ROMs and projects come along. - **Web page:** while the Plugin Manager is on a track, its status line shows an address.
